compact_relative_action_contract.FD5_centering: Evaluate S_rel at every retracted endpoint, subtract the central S_rel component before forming the FD5 numerator, and record the central scale, centered-term scale and cancellation ratio
compact_relative_action_contract.bulk_definition: For each of the twelve named bulk components integrate over its own oriented collar L_i[X]-L_i[X_infinity] before summing

bulk_domain.tangential_measure: unnormalized dx0 dx1 dx2 dx3 with total constant-mode weight (2*pi)^4

compact_relative_action_contract.compact_support_contract: Every generated perturbation equals X_infinity for rho>=1; the h0, h1 and b_j profiles are flat at rho=1, so compact variations generate no artificial outer-boundary term
excluded_interpretations: absolute action on the noncompact half-spaces
holographic counterterm or unlisted background counterterm
compact_relative_action_contract.interface_definition: GHY and the six interface components are not reference-subtracted; a route may remove only an explicitly recorded configuration-independent constant, which cancels from every directional derivative
quadrature_independence: Evaluate Fourier coefficients from the published wavevectors and labels
Do not use the N unisolvent collocation points as nonlinear quadrature nodes
Each independent route owns its tangential and radial quadrature implementation
Each route records nodes, weights, orders and simultaneous refinement data
compact_relative_action_contract.variational_equivalence: DS_rel equals the first variation of the literal v5.2 action for the published compactly supported variations

exact_action.GHY: S_GHY=M5^3*sum_eps int_Sigma sqrt(-gamma)*Theta_eps for outward normals
exact_action.removed_terms: S_X=0 and every bulk screen-clock term=0

topology_orientation.natural_B_flux_equation: sum_eps s_eps*b_eps=0 with s_plus=1 and s_minus=-1

geometry_convention.Ricci_4D: Ric_(sigma nu)=R^rho_(sigma rho nu); R4=gamma^(sigma nu)Ric_(sigma nu)
geometry_convention.Riemann_4D: R^rho_(sigma mu nu)=partial_mu Gamma^rho_(nu sigma)-partial_nu Gamma^rho_(mu sigma)+Gamma^rho_(mu lambda)Gamma^lambda_(nu sigma)-Gamma^rho_(nu lambda)Gamma^lambda_(mu sigma)
foliation: Rcal=h^mu_rho h^nu_sigma R4_(mu nu rho sigma)-Kcal^2+Kcal_mu_nu Kcal^mu_nu
khronon: u_mu=-N_T partial_mu tau_T with u_mu u^mu=-1
geometry_convention.legacy_v5_5_4_note: The v5.5.4 scalar Ward lemma may be cited only inside its stated internal sign convention; its opposite Gauss sign is not the geometric definition of leaf intrinsic curvature and requires an additive corrigendum
geometry_convention.signature: (-,+,+,+) on gamma and (-,+,+,+,+) in each bulk

common: evaluate gamma,T,log_Omega,varphi_E0,A_E0,q_Q from free Fourier coefficients
S=exp(hat(q_Q)); varphi=S varphi_E0; hat(A_Sigma)=S hat(A_E0) S^T-dS S^T

each_side: g_mu4=d_mu-a Y_mu; g_44=a, hence Y^*g=gamma pointwise

decoder.pointwise_scope: These formulas define eliminated traces at every evaluator node; ambient spectral projections from v5.6.4 are lineage hashes only

orientation: Each ordered reference collar chart (x0,x1,x2,x3,rho_epsilon) is positive
All tensor and differential-form integrands are pulled back with the full collar Jacobian
The coefficient of pulled-back B wedge F is integrated in that positive chart orientation
The boundary orientation is the contraction i_(n_out) vol_5
det[tangent_0,...,tangent_3,n_out] has sign +1 on plus and -1 on minus

frame_rotation_contract.horizontal_frame_seed: E0 is the ordered gamma-Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization of the three coordinate spatial vectors projected orthogonally to u_mu=-N_T partial_mu tau_T
frame_rotation_contract.published_frame: E_Q=E0 exp(-hat(q_Q)); source and target changes of frame act by R'=U_Q R U_source^-1. The relative r_E0 data are not counted a second time as gauge coordinates
frame_rotation_contract.published_relative_rotation: R_epsilon=exp(hat(r_epsilon)); d_mu R uses scipy.linalg.expm_frechet, never R hat(d_mu r)

primitive_component_convention.BF_component_pairing: The simultaneous A_tau/B_tau sign conversion preserves the literal v5.2 inner product <B,F>=-tr_3(BF)/2
primitive_component_convention.B_ordered_exterior_basis: The 10 stored B_MNP components multiply the ordered basis dy^M wedge dy^N wedge dy^P with M<N<P
primitive_component_convention.B_wedge_F_top_coefficient: sum over each stored B triple and its ordered complementary F pair of permutation_sign(triple,pair)*dot_tau(B_triple,F_pair), with no additional factorial
primitive_component_convention.F_ordered_exterior_basis: F_MN multiplies the ordered basis dy^M wedge dy^N with M<N
required_exterior_normalization_mutants: remove or invert the complementary-pair permutation sign
primitive_component_convention.tau_covariant_derivative: D_M phi = partial_M phi + A_M_tau cross phi

pointwise_decoder_contract.radial_basis: K(N)=N and b_j(rho)=P_j(2rho-1)*exp(4-1/[rho(1-rho)]) for j=0,...,K(N)-1 on 0<rho<1, extended by zero; this is a growing compact interior basis
pointwise_decoder_contract.radial_profiles: h0=chi and h1=rho*chi with chi=exp[-(rho/(1-rho))^2] on 0<=rho<1 give h0(0)=1,h0'(0)=0,h1(0)=0,h1'(0)=1; all perturbations vanish for rho>=1 and fields approach a fixed regular reference
